newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES UP SLIGHTLY, WAITING FOR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES UP SLIGHTLY, WAITING FOR RESULTS.

text.p: Danish share prices were slightly higher in early trade on Tuesday, with dealers seeing little action in a quiet, cautious market waiting for key corporate results and U.S. data on Wednesday.
"It is going to be dull today with the market wary ahead of U.S. retail sales data and key local corporate first-half results due tomorrow from SAS,Novo Nordisk and B&O," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.44 point to 185.53 at 0735 GMT.
